In [[mathematics]], the '''either–or topology''' is a [[topological space|topological structure]] defined on the [[closed interval]] [&minus;1,&nbsp;1] by declaring a set [[open set|open]] if it either does not contain {0} or does contain (&minus;1,&nbsp;1).
